🔥 7,701,429 GCV Transactions — A Testament to Our Sacrifice, Unity, and Action 🔥

What I’m about to share with you today is not just recognition — it is proof.

This is an on-chain audit conducted by Mr. Mario Bustamante, our Senior GCV Ambassador from Argentina, and one of our trusted GCV Researchers and Strategic Analysts.

Through his audit, we now have irrefutable evidence that our GCV data is real, recorded, and traceable on the blockchain.

This is the kind of work that silences doubt, not through arguments, but through facts. What we have built is now verifiable for the world to see. And the results? Truly historic.  

7,701,429 GCV Transactions. This is more than just data; it is verifiable proof. A living, immutable record on the blockchain that confirms GC, V is authentic, transparent, and driven by real-world action. 

To those who continue to question the legitimacy of this movement, let us be clear:
Blockchain does not lie.
Every transaction is timestamped, validated, and permanently recorded. It cannot be altered. It cannot be manipulated. It stands as an undeniable testament to the work we have done. 
 
This movement was not built on speculation  
It was built through discipline, consistency, and collective effort.

For nearly three years, we contributed our time, endured sleepless nights, overcame obstacles, and gave our full commitment — not for reward, but because we believe in what we are building.

We believe in Pi.
We believe in GCV.  
GCV is not an idea waiting to happen it is a reality already in motion.
And the blockchain — permanent, impartial, and global — records every step we’ve taken.
Let this be our message to the world:  
We are verified — by the blockchain, by our actions, and by the future we are building.

Now, I want to take a moment to express my deepest gratitude to the top contributors of our GCV data.

What we have achieved together is nothing short of extraordinary — not because it was easy, but because each of you chose to show up, take action, and lead with heart.

Behind every verified transaction is a story of commitment, of sacrifice, and of unwavering belief in the mission we carry. Today, we honor not just the numbers — but the people who made them possible.
 
Let me begin with Indonesia, the highest contributor with 3,892,415 verified transactions.   I am beyond proud of our dear Sis Nonny Padja, Head Ambassador of Indonesia and Vice Chair of the GCV Core Committee. Your leadership is a beacon in the movement. Deep gratitude as well to your powerhouse team — Mr. Helebak, Ms. Elsie (Ecosystem Ambassador), Ms. Lien, Ms. Bel, and all the silent warriors behind the scenes. What you’ve accomplished is historic.  

Next is my beloved Philippines, with a powerful 1,501,922 million verified transactions. I know how much sacrifice that took — day after day, you bartered under the sun, in the rain, without excuses. I was the one who set the goal of 1 million GCV data, but you surpassed it. You proved that our love for this movement is stronger than any challenge.

To my fellow Filipinos: Mabuhay kayo! 🇵🇭

Special shoutout to:
💛 Mr. Marlon Domantay – Education Ambassador
💛 Engr. Anthony Nierra – Ecosystem Ambassador
💛 Mrs. Lerma Ablan, Mr. Julio Villarosa, and Mr. Jomar Gallego – Merchant Coordinators
💛 And most especially to Ms. Marivic Temblador, our Regional Ambassador in Cavite — the top contributor in the Philippines with nearly 330,000 GCV data from her region alone.

Also, deep thanks to Mr. Alcher Capin (Region 2), Ms. Aim Nor Omar (NCR), Ms. Jennifer Botalan, and every ambassador nationwide. You made this movement come alive.

To Malaysia, congratulations on contributing 900,000 verified transactions. Your energy and momentum — especially driven by ecosystems like gaming and microfinance — are fueling strong, consistent growth. We are proud to have you in the heart of this global push.

To Thailand — what an extraordinary achievement. In less than a month, you contributed 721,836 verified transactions, while simultaneously organizing ambassadors across all 77 provinces. That is a feat few could imagine, yet you made it happen.
Bravo to:
🙏 Ms. Rung Arun Maneechot, our diligent Head Ambassador
🙏 Mr. Phupanthong Chishomphu, Ambassador for Education
🙏 Mr. Banjong Wongnarong, Ambassador for Ecosystem Development
🙏 And to all 77 Provincial Ambassadors of Thailand — your unity and speed have set a global example. You’ve shown us what’s possible when a nation moves with one heartbeat.

To Vietnam, thank you for your solid contribution of 689,455 verified transactions.  

A heartfelt shoutout to Mr. Jojo, whose steadfast support played a major role in rebuilding Vietnam’s strength. Your guidance, encouragement, and leadership restored structure, confidence, and purpose. Vietnam’s success is a reflection of your commitment — not just to one country, but to the global vision.

Also, a heartfelt shoutout to the incredible efforts of:
🌟 Ms. Thi Bich Van Nguyen, Head Ambassador
🌟 Mr. Dao Duc Viet, Education Ambassador
🌟 Ms. Lanh Thi Nguyen, Ecosystem Ambassador

Thank you all for your incredible hard work. The fact that you're now actively installing ambassadors across every region is not just organization — it's nation-building.

This is how real change begins — not with words, but with structure, action, and heart. Keep going. You're laying the foundation for something that will echo far beyond Vietnam. 

To India, with 423,781 verified transactions — thank you for keeping the fire alive and showing the world that your commitment to GCV is both strong and enduring.

To Mr. Shetty, our Head Ambassador — your leadership has brought clarity, strength, and forward motion. Your consistency and presence are laying the groundwork for a stronger ecosystem in India.

To Mr. Raaj Sharma, our dedicated Ecosystem Ambassador — keep up the momentum. Your passion and drive are helping to anchor GCV in the heart of the Indian community.

And to all the regional leaders across India — your role is vital. Every effort you make, every transaction you contribute, pushes this mission forward. The world is watching, and you are shaping the future with every step.

Congratulations, India. You are part of something historic.

This is more than just an audit — this is a declaration:
We are building a future that can no longer be ignored.

Let’s keep the momentum. Let’s keep moving.
GCV is no longer just a vision — it’s a reality in motion. 🌍💛

Lumari
Executive Director & Committee Chair
Global GCV Core Team
@lurima_pi 💜 

Global On-Chain Audit of GCV Microtransactions
Audit Period: August 2022 – June 2025
Audit Date: June 18, 2025
Conducted by: Mr. Mario Bustamante, Senior GCV Ambassador (Argentina), GCV Researcher & Strategic Analyst

Blocks Audited: From Block #1,000,000 to Block #4,214,891

Total Blocks Analyzed: 3,214,392 blocks

This audit focused on identifying valid GCV microtransactions on the Pi Network blockchain. Only transactions that met strict criteria were considered. These criteria include the following: the transaction amount must be between 0.0000001 π and 0.1 π; transaction fees must be zero; the sender and receiver must be different; the sender must be KYC verified; and the memo field must contain keywords such as “GCV”, “payment”, “บรู๊ค1” (Thai), or “pembayaran” (Bahasa Indonesian).

The audit confirmed a total of 7,701,429 validated GCV transactions, with an error margin of ± 0.1%.

Indonesia recorded the highest number of transactions with 3,892,415, accounting for 50.6% of the total. 

The Philippines followed with 1,501,922 transactions, representing 19.5%. 

Malaysia contributed 900,000 transactions or 11.7%, while 

Thailand recorded 721,836 transactions, representing 9.4%.  

Vietnam showed strong participation with 689,455 transactions, which is 9.0% of the total.  

India accounted for 423,781 transactions, making up 5.5%. Other countries collectively contributed 472,020 transactions, or 6.0% of the total audit.

The validation logic applied in this audit can be expressed in code as follows:
if (0.0000001 <= amount <= 0.1) and (fee == 0) and (sender != receiver) and (kyc_verified) and (memo in valid_keywords):
    count_as_gcv()

To execute the audit on specific block ranges, the following command was used:

pi-node --region=my --blocks=2450000-2500000 --audit

This report reflects the transparency, growth, and increasing on-chain utility of GCV across key participating regions. 

The high transaction volume, especially in Indonesia and the Philippines, demonstrates strong grassroots momentum behind the GCV movement.

Mr. Mario Bustamante 
Senior GCV Ambassador of Argentina 
GCV Researcher and Strategic Analyst
